notes: hemmah → 'those that': the explicit pronoun is recast as the substantival head of a relative, both words realizing the pronoun (rules 17, 18); waw keeps But. Competing reading with 'that' added under rule 55 is named in the unit note.
le-shoah 'to destruction' recast as 'to destroy it': to on le, destroy on the noun, supplied object it added (rule 44); margin set aside (rule 38).
